verdict.rationale: Gladia documents an official CLI with a one-command install-and-run flow (`gladia transcribe audio.mp3`), text/JSON/SRT/VTT output to stdout, machine-readable pipe-friendly output for scripts and CI, and shell completion. That fits AI-native scripted workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as documented, and evidence of the full command surface beyond transcribe and completion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: One command: install, set your key, run `gladia transcribe audio.mp3`
Flexible output: plain text, JSON, SRT, or VTT to stdout
Pipe-friendly: machine-readable output for scripts and CI
Generate shell tab completion (bash, zsh, fish, powershell)
